description.narrative: Seeks to strengthen the capacities of citizens in informal settlements in Nakuru City, through their organized groups (male and female youth, women and PWDS) to scale up oversight in the county budget process to facilitate the realisation of their rights. The project shall employ a social accountability approach to foster structured engagement between the target groups, County Treasury, County Assembly and Nakuru City Board. Short term, the project aims to increase knowledge and participation of targeted participants in budget making processes in Nakuru City on their constitutional rights and responsibilities in county governance. Project also expected to enhance the capacity of 25 budget champions groups to spearhead citizen-led advocacy in the county planning and budgeting processes. The project will reach 400 citizens directly and 1,200 indirectly. Greater accountability, transparency, and responsiveness from county leadership is expected to contribute to improved public service delivery and equitable distribution of resources.
